module.name: harbor-registry
module.description: Private Harbor OCI registry on an IBM Cloud VSI — the mirror a disconnected BNK install pulls its charts and images from. Creates (or adopts) the services VPC, attaches it to an existing Transit Gateway, and installs Harbor with a self-signed cert covering both its private and floating IPs.

required.name: region
required.description: IBM Cloud region for the services VPC and the Harbor VSI.

required.name: prefix
required.description: Prefix for every resource this module names (e.g. acme-svc).

required.name: ssh_key_name
required.description: Name of an existing IBM Cloud VPC SSH key to attach, for operator access to the VSI.

required.name: harbor_admin_password
required.description: Harbor admin password — also the credential the mirror blueprint pushes with and the install pulls with.

optional.name: zone
optional.description: Zone for the subnet and VSI. Blank = <region>-1.

optional.name: transit_gateway
optional.description: Name or id of an EXISTING Transit Gateway to attach the services VPC to, so the air-gapped cluster reaches Harbor privately. Blank = no attachment.

optional.name: create_vpc
optional.description: On = create the services VPC, subnet and public gateway. Off = adopt existing_vpc_id / existing_subnet_id.

optional.name: existing_vpc_id
optional.description: Existing services VPC id, when create_vpc is off.

optional.name: existing_subnet_id
optional.description: Existing subnet id, when create_vpc is off.

optional.name: subnet_cidr
optional.description: CIDR for the services subnet. MUST NOT overlap the cluster VPC: roksbnkctl fixes its cluster subnets at 10.241.0.0/24, 10.241.64.0/24 and 10.241.128.0/24, so anything in 10.241.0.0/16 risks colliding once both VPCs are on the same Transit Gateway — the cluster would route the mirror's address to its own subnet.

optional.name: public_gateway
optional.description: Attach a public gateway to the services subnet. Harbor needs egress to pull the BNK supply chain from F5.

optional.name: vsi_profile
optional.description: IBM Cloud instance profile for the Harbor VSI.

optional.name: vsi_image
optional.description: Stock image for the Harbor VSI.

optional.name: boot_size_gb
optional.description: Boot volume size. A full BNK mirror plus Harbor's offline installer needs room.

optional.name: management_allowed_cidrs
optional.description: CIDRs allowed to reach :443 and :22 on the floating IP. Blank = 0.0.0.0/0.

optional.name: registry_allowed_cidrs
optional.description: CIDRs allowed to reach :443 privately over the Transit Gateway. Blank = the RFC-1918 ranges.

optional.name: services_spare_cidr
optional.description: A second address prefix in the services VPC, reserved for appliances that allocate their own subnet from the VPC pool — roksbnkctl's FLP VSI does. A prefix that exactly equals the subnet leaves nothing to allocate. Must not overlap the subnet or the cluster VPC. Blank disables it.

optional.name: registry_projects
optional.description: Comma-separated Harbor projects to create once the registry is up. Harbor does not auto-create a project on push and `registry replicate` does not either, so a missing project surfaces as 401 Unauthorized on the manifest HEAD — which reads like a credential fault. Defaults cover the mirror target and the flp-status image project.

optional.name: vpc_name
optional.label: Services VPC name
optional.description: Explicit name for the services VPC. Blank uses <prefix>-services-vpc.

optional.name: subnet_name
optional.label: Services subnet name
optional.description: Explicit name for the services subnet. Blank uses <prefix>-services-subnet.

key_outputs.name: registry_host
key_outputs.description: Harbor's PRIVATE IP — the address the cluster nodes and the runner use over the Transit Gateway. This is what the mirror and install blueprints take.

key_outputs.name: registry_url
key_outputs.description: Harbor's browser URL on the operator floating IP.

key_outputs.name: floating_ip
key_outputs.description: Operator floating IP attached to the Harbor VSI.

key_outputs.name: vpc_id
key_outputs.description: Services VPC id — feed this to the FLP-VSI blueprint so the licensing appliance lands in the same VPC.

key_outputs.name: ssh_target
key_outputs.description: SSH target for fetching Harbor's CA (base64 at /opt/harbor/harbor-ca.b64).
